bot.welcome: Welcome! Send a supported track or album link. For a track, choose Download or another quality. For an album, download all tracks or select a subset. On your first download, you’ll choose a default quality; you can change it later with /quality.
bot.help: Send a supported track or album URL. Track Cards offer Download and one-off quality; Album Cards offer Download all, track selection, and one-off album quality. Use /quality to change the default for future requests and /language to change the interface language. Playlists are not supported.
bot.send_track_url_hint: Please send a supported track or album URL.
bot.unsupported_url: That is not a supported track or album URL.
bot.unsupported_media_type: Only individual tracks and supported albums are available right now; playlists are not supported.
bot.track_resolution_failed: I couldn’t resolve this track right now. Please try again later.
bot.choose_default_quality:
Choose your default download quality:

MP3 128 — smaller file, broad compatibility
MP3 320 — higher-bitrate MP3
AAC 256 — efficient high-quality AAC
Lossless — original lossless quality when available

This quality will become your default for future downloads. You can change it later with /quality.
